units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 174a:8">B. Bath. 174ᵃ</cite> <he>כולן לשון ע׳ הן</he> all these expressions mean only guaranty, opp. to <cite ref="S00078"><he>קבלנות</he></cite> an unconditional agreement to pay a neighbor’s debt.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93:1">Gen. R. s. 93</cite>, beg. <he>מלעשות ע׳ בין אדם לחבירו</he> from going security in transactions between a man and his neighbor (v. <cite ref="P01273"><he>עֵרָבוֹן</he> II</cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 150:2">Yalk. ib. 150</cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:30">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 121</cite> <he>עשינו עֲרֵבוּתֵינוּ עשה וכ׳</he> we have done what we were pledged to do, do thou now thy duty.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 27:9">Ex. R. s. 27</cite> <he>הכנסת עצמך לע׳ זו ליעשות ראש</he> (not <cite ref="G00078"><he>זה</he></cite>) thou hast made thyself enter this pledge, that thou mayest become the head (victor in the contest).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 27:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ומה היתה עֲרֵבוּתָן</he> and what was their pledge? (Answ. ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 24:7">Ex. XXIV, 7</cite>).
<cite ref="Exodus 24:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ואם לאו תענשו בע׳</he> but if you will not guard the Law, you will be fined by that pledge (forfeit your children’s life). Tanḥ. Vayigg. 5; a. e.
